name: A Green Valley Construction

niche_evidence.quote: General Contractor & Home Remodeling Services in Massachusetts

niche_evidence_2.quote: We do the best to design and install the best outdoor living space.

niche_notes: Homepage hero names the firm a general contractor. The services menu lists Bathrooms, Customized projects, Decking, Flooring, Hardscape, Home Remodeling and Kitchens, and the homepage service cards lead with Customized projects; on-site Google reviews describe decks, stairs, a patio gazebo and basements. The page title says 'Kitchen Remodeling & Home Renovation' but kitchens and baths are two of seven trades, so this is a multi-trade general contractor under the run notes.
g4_notes: Not reached: stopped at NICHE. Packet social_post (Facebook 2026-10-05, user-supplied via Gemini) not re-checked; user-supplied Google review is dated 2026-05-11 (outside the window). wp-json/wp/v2/posts returned an empty list, so no site_dated_content exists to find.
g3_notes: Footer credit links to https://hima.pro/ (raw: 'By Hima').
assessment: Opinion: a family-run Westborough, MA general contractor doing decks, hardscape, flooring and remodels alongside kitchens and baths; not a kitchen and bath specialist.
inference_rejected: Homepage names 'Matheus and Patricia' as founders by first name only, and a Google review on the site calls 'Matt' the owner; neither is a full name with a role on a company page (not needed, since NICHE failed).
Page title 'Kitchen Remodeling & Home Renovation' not taken as primary advertised work because the hero and services menu present a multi-trade general contractor.

name: Alba Kitchen and Bath - East Hanover

niche_evidence.quote: Alba Kitchen and Bath is one of the largest cabinet dealers in NJ.

niche_evidence_2.quote: Visit our kitchen cabinet showrooms conveniently located in

niche_notes: A cabinet dealer with showrooms; site menus and footer lead with cabinet sales ('Kitchen Cabinet Deals', 'Kitchen Cabinets by Brands', 'Fabuwood Cabinets', 'Countertop Specials'). The East Hanover page mentions 'licensed installers' and 'kitchen remodeling services', but the business describes itself as a cabinet dealer, which fails NICHE under the run notes. It would also fail G5: three showrooms (Hasbrouck Heights, Metuchen, East Hanover) are listed on /contact, a multi-location chain.
g4_notes: Not reached: stopped at NICHE. Packet social_post (Facebook 2026-09-04, user-supplied via Gemini) not re-checked; user-supplied Google review is dated 2025-07-24 (outside the window). Sitemap index shows blog-posts-sitemap lastmod 2025-11-21 (sitemap dates alone do not count).
g3_notes: Wix site; footer reads '(c) 2025 Alba Kitchen and Bath' with no web or marketing vendor credit on the showroom and contact pages. Homepage returned a 'Checking Your Request' bot page on every attempt.
g5_notes: Fails G5 as well (not the recorded stop): /contact lists 'Alba Kitchen and Bath - Hasbrouck Heights', '- Metuchen' and '- East Hanover'.
assessment: Opinion: a three-showroom New Jersey cabinet dealer selling design and cabinets with installation, not an independent kitchen and bath remodeller.
inference_rejected: 'Dedicated designers and licensed installers' and 'kitchen remodeling services' not taken as primary advertised work, because the same paragraph calls the firm one of the largest cabinet dealers in NJ.
could_not_check: Homepage text (bot challenge page each time)

name: Amega Enterprises LLC

niche_evidence.quote: Full Service Remodeling Contractor in the South Jersey Area

niche_evidence_2.quote: All your renovation and management needs for commercial projects!

niche_notes: Multi-trade contractor. The homepage does say 'specializes in kitchen remodels, bathroom remodels and any other home improvement', but the residential list adds custom trim, tile, flooring, interior and exterior painting, power washing, doors, windows, decks and lighting; /services is a commercial list (Equipment Install, Signs, Mirror Install, Painting, Windows); the homepage also offers help buying or selling renovated homes. Visible Google reviews cover whole-home painting and exterior roof, siding and windows work.
g4_notes: Not reached: stopped at NICHE. Packet google_review 2026-08-15 (user-supplied via Gemini) not re-checked. Site has no blog (/blog, /careers.html and /sitemap.xml return stub pages); only social link is Facebook.
g3_notes: Network Solutions site builder (nccdn.net assets); footer shows address, phone and email only, no vendor credit.
assessment: Opinion: a Medford, NJ full-service residential and commercial remodelling contractor; kitchens and baths are listed first but sit among many trades.
inference_rejected: The homepage sentence 'specializes in kitchen remodels, bathroom remodels and any other home improvement' was weighed but not accepted as primary advertised work, given the commercial services page and the multi-trade lists.
/about.html calls Bill Steffen 'lead general contractor' and lists him under 'Our Team Supervisors'; that is not an ownership role (not needed, since NICHE failed).
